title: Identifying Barriers Hindering the Acceptance of Generative AI as a Work Associate, measured with the new AGAWA scale
reasoning: The paper introduces and validates the AGAWA scale, which is specifically designed to measure human attitudes towards Generative AI across two primary dimensions: pragmatic and moral. A core component of the study is evaluating 'moral resistance' and 'moral objection' (as measured by specific items in the scale like S7) as key barriers to the acceptance of AI as a work collaborator.
